messages:
emma: Tiny watercooler challenge: assemble a 3-song "pocket therapy" — songs you can shove in your pocket and play anywhere to reset. also drop one book or show that's weirdly compatible. i'll go.
raj: 1) King Krule - Easy Easy 2) Toro y Moi - Talamak 3) Fiona Apple - Paper Bag. Book: The Secret History (for dramatic vibes).
olivia: mine: 1) Otis Redding - Try a Little Tenderness 2) Snail Mail - Pristine 3) Phantogram - When I'm Small. Show pair: Ramy S1 — messy, cathartic.
tom: mostly instrumental for me: 1) Explosions in the Sky - Your Hand in Mine 2) Tycho - Awake 3) Nils Frahm - Says. Perfect for heads-down calm.
lina: guilty meme pick included: 1) Boney M - Rasputin (instant dance) 2) Arlo Parks - Hurt 3) LCD Soundsystem - Someone Great. Book: Never Let Me Go.
emma: @lina rasputin is a mood :joy: also quick micro-poll idea  react with :heart: for most therapeutic, :fire: for most energizing, :laughing: for most unexpectedly delightful.
raj: :heart: on Tom's list — instrumental reset all the way.
olivia: :fire: for Boney M because it's absurd and works.
music-bot: Playlist "pocket-therapy-2759876543" created (18 tracks).
tom: office logistics quick note: if you're borrowing a book from the shelf by the kitchen, please leave a sticky with your name. mine still has that weird bookmark.
lina: noted, i'll add sticky notes today. also anyone want to swap a sci-fi rec? i'm in a mood for a short, punchy novella.
emma: try All Systems Red (Murderbot novella) — short & snarky. pairs well with Tom's instrumental list for focus reads.
olivia: can someone queue these in the office playlist? i'm on rotations this week and can add stuff late tonight.
emma: @olivia please do! i'll DM the spotify link. thanks everyone, this was cheer-up gold.
